integrity: Analytic proof supplied; reproducibility checks are rational finite tests, not a substitute for unlimited-domain proof. No human or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary two-site linear Gaussian autoregression; the proof concerns exact moments, no observation error or dispersal. The sharp lag lower bound refers to explicitly listed moments, not all possible cross-lag information. Near equality of environmental coefficients causes ill conditioning.
title: Heterogeneous environmental memory resolves a shared demographic-filter ambiguity
